message.content:
**Uno – Basic Rules (Standard Edition)** | Item | Details | |------|---------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or agree on a different target). Points are earned by being the first to discard all cards in your hand and then scoring the sum of the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 2–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 25 of each color (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) numbered 0–9 plus two of each action card per color (Skip, Reverse, Draw Two). 4 Wild cards and 4 Wild Draw Four cards. | | **Setup** | Shuffle the deck. Deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile; flip the top card to start the discard pile. If the first card is an action card, its effect applies to the first player. | | **Turn Sequence** | 1. **Draw** – If you cannot play a card from your hand that matches the top discard in color, number, or symbol, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played immediately, you may do so; otherwise, your turn ends.
2. **Play** – Place one card from your hand onto the discard pile if it matches the top card in color, number, or symbol, or if it’s a Wild card.
3. **Action** – Resolve any action card effects (see below).
4. **End Turn** – Pass play clockwise (or counterclockwise if a Reverse has been played). | | **Playable Cards** | • Same color (any number or action).
• Same number (any color).
• Same symbol (action cards).
• Wild cards (can be played at any time). | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – Reverses direction of play. (With 2 players, acts like Skip.)
• **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – Player declares next color.
• **Wild Draw Four** – Player declares next color; next player draws four cards and skips their turn. (Can only be played if the player has no matching color; otherwise, the play can be challenged.) | | **Calling “UNO”** | When you have one card left, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn. Failure to call UNO when required results in a penalty: the player who missed the call must draw two cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards still held by opponents: numbers count as face value, action cards count as 20 points, Wild cards count as 50 points. | | **Scoring & Winning the Game** | Keep a running total of points. The first player to reach the agreed‑upon target (commonly 500) wins the game. | --- ### Common Variations | Variation | Description | |-----------|-------------| | **Stacking** | Some groups allow stacking of Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards: if a Draw Two is played, the next player may play another Draw Two to pass the penalty upward, adding up to four cards drawn. Similar rule for Wild Draw Four. | | **No Challenge** | In casual play, the Wild Draw Four rule is often ignored; players simply play it whenever they wish. | | **Custom Decks** | Uno offers themed decks (e.g., Disney, Marvel). Rules remain the same; just use the corresponding deck. | | **House Rules** | Many groups add house rules such as “Draw One” (draw one card instead of two), “Color Change” (players can change color without playing a Wild), or “No Penalty for UNO” (no penalty for forgetting to call UNO). | Feel free to adapt or combine variations to suit your group’s preferences!
